reason: The original reports a .format() call whose string mixes automatic and numbered fields: `"{} {1}".format(1, 2)` and `"{0} {}".format(1, 2)` (pyflakes/F525.py:1, 2; rerail/noqa/F525.py:1, 5, 7, 9).
